algorithm.name: RTPM / Algorithm 1
required_steps: split samples into T fresh blocks
restart from every standard basis vector
apply top-r truncation and normalization after every block
select the final candidate by empirical Rayleigh quotient

acceptance: sample threshold calibrated independently of the theorem formula
binomial confidence interval reported over deterministic seeds
negative controls rejected for their intended reasons
independent checker exits nonzero on tampered evidence
Theorem 2 to Theorem 1 specialization checked symbolically
